title: incident-bot: on-call telemetry enrichment for automated diagnostics
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Add enriched telemetry for on-call incidents: include SLO context and runbook links in incident summaries; new telemetry events and backfill script; minor schema bump for telemetry consumers
description: Motivation: automated diagnostics and runbook linking for on-call flows were often missing important context (SLO metadata, canonical runbook link, recent deploys) which made triage noisy and delayed remediation. This PR enriches the incident-bot telemetry and on-call summaries to include standard SLO context, canonical runbook links when available, service version/deploy tags, and a compact intent score for automated diagnostic suggestions. Changes: 1) Add new telemetry event types (oncall.incident.context, oncall.runbook.suggestion) and accompanying schema; 2) Enrich Slack/ops-channel messages with runbook canonical links and an SLO summary block (objective, current burn, time window); 3) Add a backfill script (scripts/migration/backfill_telemetry.py) to populate the new event for the last 30 days of incidents for downstream analytics; 4) Guard enrichment behind feature flag INCIDENT_ONCALL_TELEMETRY to allow staged rollout; 5) Add unit and e2e tests, update docs and examples; 6) Update telemetry consumers README and producer contract (telemetry/events.py). Checklist: - [x] Telemetry schema approved - [x] Unit tests added - [x] E2E test (simulated incident) - [x] Backfill script and dry-run tested on staging - [x] Feature flag gating implemented - [x] Docs updated (docs/incident-bot/telemetry.md). Impact: this is backwards-compatible for consumers (new optional fields), low runtime cost (one additional read to runbook index cache), and enables higher-quality automated diagnostics and SLO-linked runbook suggestions. Related: ENG-5432, SRE-210. Deployment notes: enable feature flag in a canary org, run backfill with --dry-run on staging, monitor telemetry consumer schema errors.
